import re

# Extract date from title like "Habit Tracking Log for 2023-05-17"
date_pattern = re.compile(r'Habit Tracking Log for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})')

# Parse each note
parsed_notes = []
for nd in notes_data:
    title = nd['title']
    m = date_pattern.search(title)
    if not m:
        print(f"Could not parse date from title: {title}")
        continue
    date_str = m.group(1)
    content = nd['content']
    # Extract habit lines: lines that contain ": yes" or ": no"
    habits = {}
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if ': yes' in line or ': no' in line:
            # Split on last colon
            parts = line.rsplit(':', 1)
            if len(parts) == 2:
                habit = parts[0].strip()
                value = parts[1].strip().lower()
                if value in ('yes', 'no'):
                    habits[habit] = value
    parsed_notes.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})

print(f"Parsed {len(parsed_notes)} notes")
# Show first note's habits
print(parsed_notes[0])
